thread:
maya: quick idea — can we add a "cost clarity" console widget that shows per-route SLA impact alongside token-level cost and 'shared cache' savings attribution? thinking of a small table + sparklines.
sash: yes please. current chargebacks are opaque when cache kicks in. ops teams ask why route A shows low tokens but high bill.
liam: how would we attribute shared cache? prefix caching is messy — a single cached KV can benefit many routes.
maya: proposal sketch — show column: raw_tokens, served_from_cache_tokens, effective_billable_tokens (raw - cache_credits), amortized_shared_cache_credit. also an 'SLA risk' score from tracing that flags increased latency when using cheaper fallbacks.
arjun: +1 on SLA risk. but amortization needs a clear formula. otherwise disputes will start. suggest: amortized_shared_cache_credit = shared_cache_hits * (route_hit_fraction / total_hit_fraction) * model_unit_cost
nina: oof that will be confusing to customers. maybe expose both: an algorithmic split for internal chargeback and a "visible savings" figure that's route-specific (what you would have been billed without cache for that route's traffic profile).
sash: agree. internal vs visible split is neat. internal = fair allocation for accounting. visible = what product teams see in dashboard to explain savings.
liam: implementation constraints — we only have per-request telemetry every Nth request (sampling). do we interpolate? we can't afford to trace 100% for hot routes.
maya: we can keep efficient sampling. idea: maintain per-route rolling counters for total_requests, sampled_requests, sampled_cache_hits, sampled_raw_tokens. then estimate cache_hit_rate = sampled_cache_hits / sampled_requests and scale to total_requests. include confidence interval.
arjun: add a column showing sampling confidence and a small badge if CI > 10% we recommend raising sampling for that route for a day.
nina: UX: don't hide the formula. users want to click into "how this is calculated" and see the math + example. add a small "explain" modal.
sash: also need to prevent double-crediting when requests traverse multiplexed models (chains). if route A calls model X then chain uses model Y, cache crediting should prefer attributing to the first cacheable response.
maya: good point. propose simple precedence rule: attribute to first downstream cacheable op, with a link to the invocation path in traces. if ambiguous, split by token contribution.
liam: backend note: we'll need a tiny metadata change on invocation records to include 'route_id' and 'cache_hit_tag' so batch de-dupe can compute hits per route. low risk.
arjun: here's a quick SQL-ish pseudo to estimate visible_savings per route from sampled data:
```sql
SELECT route_id,
  SUM(total_tokens) as raw_tokens,
  SUM(sampled_cache_hits)/SUM(sampled_requests) as est_cache_hit_rate,
  (raw_tokens * est_cache_hit_rate) as est_cache_saved_tokens,
  est_cache_saved_tokens * model_unit_cost as visible_savings_usd
FROM route_samples
WHERE window = CURRENT_WINDOW
GROUP BY route_id;
```
nina: neat. include an option to toggle model_unit_cost between current SKU and a fallback 'on-demand' price for what they'd pay if not on Dedicated.
sash: rollout plan: start as internal lab under "Cost Lab" in console, opt-in per org. collect feedback for 2 weeks, then surface to product teams.
maya: can we also wire a small canary for UI: show the widget to 5% of internal orgs and log user interactions (expand explain modal, toggle sampling) to a telemetry stream.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feature/lab-cost-clarity -> staging at 2026-03-24T02:00Z
liam: integration tests: validate estimation routine with synthetic data that includes skewed prefixes and chain calls. add one test that asserts no negative billable tokens.
arjun: Ops note: remember privacy — some customers want token-level obfuscation. we should support a 'noise' mode that adds ±X% noise to visible_savings for externally visible dashboards.
nina: yeah flag in org settings: "anonymize_cost_breakdown" toggles noise and reduces sampling rate for privacy.
sash: final ask from me: add a small SLO chart inline — 95th latency before/after fallback for that route for the same window. that'll immediately surface risk.
maya: perfect. i'll draft the console mock and a short spec for metrics/DB columns. i'll post the prototype image later. who can pair on the backend PR? @liam + @arjun?
liam: me.
arjun: me.
maya: awesome. I'll open a tracking ticket with tasks: spec, db migration, sampling job, UI mock, canary flag, telemetry. tag: cost-clarity-widget.
ops-bot: note: created ticket CIW-4021 'cost-clarity-widget spec' assigned maya, liam, arjun
nina: one more: include a small explainer in the console about "Why visible_savings != invoice". prevents support noise.
maya: yes. add to spec. thanks all :tada:"
